Name: Dialogue Keys - Control Interaction Responses With Keys
Author: PokeBenji
Description:
[b]DialogueKeys[/b] makes interacting with dialogue a lot easier. You can use the number keys (1-9) to pick your dialogue options. You can also navigate through the dialogue options with the arrow keys and select your choice with Enter. It’s a simple tweak that makes the game more enjoyable. Give it a shot!
